name: E-commerce Marketing Framework
description: Comprehensive templates for online stores, digital products, subscription services, and e-commerce brands

pain_points: Uncertainty about product quality when buying online
Concerns about payment security and data privacy
Shipping costs and delivery time expectations
Overwhelming product choices and decision fatigue
Trust issues with unfamiliar online brands

value_propositions.template: Premium quality [product category] with [guarantee period] satisfaction guarantee - love it or return it free
Skip the store hassle - get [product category] delivered to your door in [timeframe] with free shipping
Get premium [product category] at direct-to-consumer prices - no middleman markup
Expertly curated [product category] collection - we test everything so you don't have to

physical_products.template: [Product name] solves [customer problem] with [key benefits]. Made from [materials/features], this [product type] delivers [specific outcomes] that [target audience] love. Perfect for [use cases].
physical_products.cta: Add to cart - Free shipping over $[amount]

digital_products.template: Get instant access to [product name] and [primary benefit] starting today. This [product type] includes [key features] and helps you [desired outcome] without [common struggle].

subscription_products.template: Never run out of [product category] again. Get [product name] delivered [frequency] with [customization options] and save [percentage]% compared to one-time purchases.

abandoned_cart_sequence.template: Hi [Customer Name], you left [product name] in your cart. Complete your order in the next [timeframe] and get free shipping!
Still thinking about [product name], [Customer Name]? Here's what other customers are saying: [testimonial]. 10% off if you complete your order today.
Last chance, [Customer Name]! Your cart expires soon. Don't miss out on [product name] - only [quantity] left in stock.

post_purchase_sequence.template: Order confirmed, [Customer Name]! Your [product name] will arrive [delivery date]. Track your order: [tracking link]
Great news, [Customer Name]! Your [product name] is on its way and will arrive [delivery date]. Here's how to get the most from your purchase: [usage tips]
Your [product name] should have arrived, [Customer Name]! How do you like it? Leave a review and get 15% off your next order.

product_guides: Complete buyer's guide to [product category]: What to look for
How to choose the right [product type] for your [use case]
[Product category] care and maintenance: Extend lifespan
Common [product category] mistakes and how to avoid them
Getting the most from your [product]: Tips and tricks
industry_insights: Latest trends in [industry]: What's driving consumer behavior
Behind the scenes: How we source and create [product category]
Sustainability in [industry]: Our commitment and practices
Customer spotlight: How [customer type] uses [product category]
Innovation showcase: New features and improvements to [product]

trust_builders: Secure payment badges and SSL certificates
Customer service contact information and hours
Free shipping thresholds and delivery promises
Social media presence and customer engagement
social_proof_types: Product reviews with photos and detailed feedback
Customer testimonials focusing on results and satisfaction
Awards and certifications for products or company
urgency_creators: Low stock notifications and inventory counters
